title: Brennan's conjecture and the integral-means spectrum

result.label: Brennan's conjecture and the integral-means spectrum
result.statement: Proves Brennan's conjecture: for every conformal bijection ϕ from a simply connected plane domain onto the disk, | '|^s is area-integrable for 4/3 s 4. The sharp universal integral-means identity is B S (t)=|t|-1 for t ≤ −2. A strict bound Bb(-1) 1/4 for bounded univalent functions disproves Kraetzer's prediction at that parameter.
